levels.stable: Selected for the supported 0.1.x contract and protected by local deterministic gates; this classification activates as a SemVer promise only at RC.
levels.beta: Implemented and useful, but missing one or more release-grade host, corpus, portability, or completeness gates.
levels.experimental: Intentional research or bounded preview surface; semantics, completeness, or host support may change before promotion.

capabilities.title: Typed Rust authoring with pc!, pcx!, Style, and StyleId
capabilities.scope: Visible literals, statically enumerable conditional branches, sealed Style construction, Cargo dependency renames, and class interoperability.
graduationCriteria: Keep the selected public API compiling on Rust 1.85.
Preserve frozen identity/class vectors for identical semantic inputs.
limitations: The full public Rust workspace surface and crate boundaries are not stable application API.

capabilities.title: Deterministic typed-utility CSS compilation
capabilities.scope: Semantic lowering, conflict detection, target transformation, pretty/minified output, and deterministic manifests for typed inputs.
graduationCriteria: Retain byte identity and MSRV package replay.
Keep backend target configuration versioned.
limitations: This does not claim a complete arbitrary standard-CSS compile/minify product path.

capabilities.title: Typed TOML themes and Cargo theme bridge
capabilities.scope: Schema-1 TOML themes, theme! build integration, bounded input, and versioned theme identity/artifacts.
graduationCriteria: Preserve format rejection and exact-version bridge behavior.
limitations: Build helper implementation types remain internal.

capabilities.title: One-shot compiler, inspection, catalog, explain, and format CLI
capabilities.scope: Documented finite commands, structured failures, atomic outputs, and read-only check modes.
graduationCriteria: Keep documented flags and successful output bytes compatible through 0.1.x.
limitations: Watch is classified separately because it is a long-lived producer.

capabilities.title: Standard-CSS audit and equivalent human/JSON/SARIF reports
capabilities.scope: Bounded standard-CSS ingestion and equivalent canonical finding projections with exact spans.
graduationCriteria: Maintain finding/severity/span parity across all three projections.
limitations: Complete declaration and selector policy coverage is not implied.

capabilities.title: Bounded filesystem input and rollback-capable publication
capabilities.scope: No-follow bounded reads, link/reparse rejection, coordinated locks, collision-safe reservations, rollback, and optional durability.
graduationCriteria: Retain Windows and Unix contract tests and dependency-light leaf crates.
limitations: Grouped publication is rollback-capable, not cross-file crash-atomic.

capabilities.title: Versioned Baseline compatibility policy
capabilities.scope: Official-data-bound profiles and fail-closed decisions for the currently classified feature set.
graduationCriteria: Classify the supported declaration and selector corpus completely.
Add reviewed fallback and browser evidence for transformed/degraded decisions.
limitations: The rule-feature set is bounded and not complete CSS classification.

capabilities.title: DTCG resolver bridge and canonical token graph
capabilities.scope: DTCG 2025.10 adapter, bounded resolver, aliases, derived values, themes, deprecations, selections, cycles, and coverage.
graduationCriteria: Obtain hosted portability evidence for CLI, bundle, and Cargo bridges.
Freeze adapter compatibility policy for 0.1.x.
limitations: DTCG is an exchange adapter, not the internal semantic model.

capabilities.title: Semantic and physical provenance graphs
capabilities.scope: Reachability-bound semantic ownership and exact final-CSS rule/declaration tracing.
graduationCriteria: Prove hosted cross-OS bytes for representative adapters.
Demonstrate complete supported-host source collection without inferred ownership.
limitations: Framework collection completeness is adapter-attested and build-graph bounded.

capabilities.title: Declarative bundles, Asset Plans, and Project Index
capabilities.scope: Explicit bundle partitions, load selection, source backlinks, and final CSS references.
graduationCriteria: Pass representative non-PliegoRS and PliegoRS applications.
Freeze supported adapter producer APIs at RC.
limitations: Automatic partitioning belongs to adapters, not the generic compiler.

capabilities.title: Budgets, ownership, usage evidence, retention, and pruning
capabilities.scope: File/layer/package/route budgets, exact ownership, observed/unobserved/dead/unknown states, retention, and whole-StyleId pruning.
graduationCriteria: Add generic-CSS declaration/token usage identities.
Close hosted route/package regression evidence.
limitations: Sampled absence never proves deadness; pruning removes whole generated StyleId rule sets only.

capabilities.title: Static accessibility policy
capabilities.scope: Declared contrast, motion, focus visibility, forced colors, and input-modality checks with explicit uncertainty and exceptions.
graduationCriteria: Measure precision/recall on a reviewed corpus.
Add browser/manual validation evidence and hosted macOS/ARM64 coverage.
limitations: This is static policy evidence and never WCAG certification.

capabilities.title: Bounded agent repair, apply, and verification receipts
capabilities.scope: Low-risk exact edits, budgets, authorization, rollback, built-in checks, fixed test/browser evidence, and canonical receipts.
graduationCriteria: Add reviewed real-incident authority and efficacy evidence.
Define hosted signer/approval protocol and required browser matrix.
limitations: Synthetic authority evidence is not agent efficacy; browser evidence currently has one pinned Chromium profile.

capabilities.title: LSP, VS Code, and Neovim clients
capabilities.scope: Completion, hover, diagnostics, formatting, cancellation, and Project Index navigation over bounded full-sync documents.
graduationCriteria: Obtain hosted extension-host evidence on supported OSes.
Publish and version client/server installation compatibility.
limitations: Editor packages are unreleased and host gates require explicit environment configuration.

capabilities.title: Read-only migration inventory bridges
capabilities.scope: Bounded Sass, Tailwind v4, CSS Modules, consumer, and auxiliary inventory without executing source toolchains.
graduationCriteria: Add representative scale and broader configured importer/load-path evidence.
Deliver reversible codemods with visual verification for promoted migrations.
limitations: Role precision is not semantic migration accuracy; no perfect-migration claim is made.

capabilities.title: Exact-snapshot watch producer
capabilities.scope: Event-assisted snapshot fallback, source/theme caches, last-valid output retention, and grouped publication.
graduationCriteria: Pass hosted long-running watch/recovery tests on supported OSes.
Publish supported latency and resource envelopes.
limitations: It regenerates artifacts; it is not CSS-only browser HMR.

capabilities.title: PliegoRS SSR/SSG, reachability, and resumability integration
capabilities.scope: Registry-driven collection, route/island bundles, SSG verification, preload, and one resumable Chromium fixture.
graduationCriteria: Pass multiple representative PliegoRS applications and hosted browser/OS matrices.
Activate the selected adapter API contract in a release.
limitations: Current evidence is a pinned bounded fixture and built target graph, not all feature/target permutations.

capabilities.title: Static cascade explanation
capabilities.scope: One author stylesheet, simple declared element, top-level layers, importance, specificity, source order, and a closed longhand set.
graduationCriteria: Cover multiple sheets/origins, inline styles, inheritance, custom properties, logical properties, and supported selectors.
Add browser continuation for cases reported as browser-required.
limitations: It intentionally returns browser-required rather than emulating full computed style.

capabilities.title: General standard-CSS transform and bundle path
capabilities.scope: Planned normal-CSS parse, normalize, target-transform, bundle, and minify product path.
graduationCriteria: Implement deterministic generic CSS transform/minify output.
Close complete supported classification and package replay on representative applications.
limitations: Current normal-CSS support is audit-first; typed utilities own the implemented compile path.

capabilities.title: Responsive and layout browser diagnosis
capabilities.scope: Planned viewport matrices, perturbations, causal ranking, visual/focus/interaction evidence, and explicit confidence.
graduationCriteria: Implement a bounded browser evidence schema and reviewed diagnostic corpus.
Reach category-specific precision without alert fatigue.
limitations: Current Chromium smokes validate known fixtures and are not responsive failure localization.

capabilities.title: Registry packages and supported installation
capabilities.scope: Future publication of the exact-version 19-crate graph and installable CLI/editor artifacts.
graduationCriteria: Resolve repository and registry ownership approvals.
Replay published artifacts with Rust 1.85 and supported hosts.
Cut an RC that activates the documented SemVer subset.
limitations: Nothing is currently uploaded; checkout revision plus Cargo.lock remains the distribution identity.
